hook.from: Geography > Location, Terrain, Natural resources; Economy > Exports
hook.excerpt: Southern Africa, bordering the South Atlantic Ocean, between Angola and South Africa || mostly high plateau; Namib Desert along coast; Kalahari Desert in east || the Namib Desert, after which the country is named, is considered to be the oldest desert in the world; some 14% of the land is protected, including virtually the entire Namib Desert coastal strip || Resources: diamonds, copper, uranium, gold, silver, lead, tin, lithium, cadmium, tungsten, zinc, salt, hydropower, fish || Exports: gold, diamonds, radioactive chemicals, fish, refined petroleum (2023)

physicalGeography.excerpt: mostly high plateau; Namib Desert along coast; Kalahari Desert in east || Southern Africa, bordering the South Atlantic Ocean, between Angola and South Africa

climate.excerpt: desert; hot, dry; rainfall sparse and erratic || prolonged periods of drought

economy.excerpt: upper middle-income, export-driven Sub-Saharan economy; natural resource rich; Walvis Bay port expansion for trade; high potential for renewable power generation and energy independence; major nature-based tourist locale; natural resource rich; shortage of skilled labor || Exports: gold, diamonds, radioactive chemicals, fish, refined petroleum (2023) || Industries: mining, tourism, fishing, agriculture
